arms.name: exposed

arms.input: Read ports receive 3 * actual_fact_A and 3 * actual_fact_B by fixed name, independent of query order. Witnessed snapshot kept for custody. Oracle/content exposure only, never a candidate selector or address lesson.

arms.representation: Duplicate keys/values/cues scaled by 1/sqrt(2); same total query/read coordinates as H2, one selector, unchanged match/read norm

arms.comparison: Measured full neuron+transport work matched to H2; unmatched work gives no efficiency/head-specific claim
arms.name: H1-work

arms.kind: acquired-copy selection-interface interventions and frozen newborn controls
arms.name: frozen-shuffled

budget.charged: All training, evaluation, oracle diagnostics, retention/probes, attempted phases/transports and refusals; deadlines between bounded trials
budget.stop: Capped/unrun cells fail to establish gate and stay in denominator; separately declare later-stage budget before runs if total will not fit; no paid/cloud campaign

protocol.candidate_selection: One equation round includes all heads/resource controls; try linear only after retained agreement failure. No per-arm parameter grid or tuning on held-out/confirmation. Keep simpler H1 if it passes.
protocol.confirmation_status: unopened; requires all development gates and a separately declared total budget

causal_controls: head permutation with downstream transport custody explicit
gates.content_use: supplied_reads uses the H2 anatomy with memory energy off, exposing both actual fact events by fixed A/B identity at its read ports, independent of query order. Require .95 exact pair, each slot, unequal-value pairs and each query on the 48 training cases, on both founders; report the 16 held-out cases separately. Final-answer teacher only; no candidate address lessons. H1 is not given two independent facts through an invented extra read.
gates.exposed_panel: All 48 training cases: exact pair, each slot, unequal-value pairs and each query; both development founders. The 16 held-out cases are reported separately.
gates.promotion: All development gates must pass on both founders 0 and 1 before confirmation; retain failures, refusals and caps. No library or default promotion from this experiment.
gates.retention: Continue balanced training on the same 12 pairs, then read the held-out panel; retain .95 on the training panel. No competing-task or P7 claim.

protocol.heads: Shared bank; disjoint live query/read ports; same complete query initial drive; query-cortex projections zero initially, ordinary reciprocal read-cortex seams independently drawn. Total coupling3 shared equally over independent heads; no supplied head-to-name assignment.
protocol.preservation: Retain previous failed admission/coupled-reader receipts and existing gates. Reward custody, private imagination, complete checkpoint continuation, continuing context/recovery and learned semantic codes remain separate requirements before integration.
protocol.primary_boundary: Clear working trace and warm neural state after prefix before query in training/evaluation, keep only witnessed memory bank. Live query/read/association/motor coordinates all qualify jointly. Intact-trace comparison is later and separate.

representation_phase.claim: Task-context accessibility and held-out readout transfer, not general meaning
controls: fixed random observation code separately labeled if run
same ambiguous cue with swapped witnessed facts
representation_phase.later_semantic_gate: Separately freeze learned-code recipe/source/budget and compare raw, fixed-random, learned, no-top-down; require held-out alias/group members without raw overlap, misleading raw overlap, member-specific facts and early facts after competition. Geometric shifts alone do not pass.
representation_phase.probe: Two diagnostic ridge readouts to one-hot requested values, fit on trainingpairs only; centered features, ridge0.01; freeze before held-out and swapped panels; never installed as answer path or teaching rule
representation_phase.start: Only after primary acquisition/content/retrieval/causal gates pass
representation_phase.variable: Free settled association activation, not context-free held LearnedCode output

protocol.scope: Synthetic component: two independently required shared-token bindings retrieved in one final settle; no learned semantic-code or integrated-life claim.

source.freeze: Commit protocol and all executed runner/anatomy/teaching bytes before the first behavioral run; record actual commit and source hashes in each receipt. Baseline is provenance, not an assertion that the uncommitted heads prototype already exists there.

task.evaluation: Enumerate all training and held-out cases once; exact pair, each slot, unequal pairs and each query reported; refused/unrun answers count wrong
task.facts: IS + name + value; two actual fact events, both orders balanced, then one neutral event
task.query: AMBIGUOUS_CUE + ASK_AB or ASK_BA; no values or intermediate address
task.schedule: SeedSequence([622022, founder]); each round samples 16 training cases with replacement; every arm uses identical draws
task.swapped_panel: Exchange values attached to A/B with query, fact order and token multiset fixed; held-out swaps stay held out; equal-value swaps are shams
task.training_pairs: All remaining 12 ordered pairs; all equal pairs and every value under each name remain in training

protocol.teaching: Capture complete pre-query drive and immutable bank before greedy act; wrong-pair rows only, both final labels supplied; no head role, slot index, address, intermediate value or relevance mask taught. Corresponding rows of captured drive and bank remain together through free/nudged phases.
